PART IV.  MANAGEMENT OF STOCK FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS

 

     §412:3-400  Applicability of part.  This part shall govern the management of all Hawaii financial institutions that are stock financial institutions. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
